name: Yoshida Aikou's Valentine's Day - A Not So Eternal Memory
source: Yoshida Aikou is just a simple second year in high school. She has a kind heart. That's why, this Valentine's Day, she's giving every boy in her school chocolate! Join her in her wild adventure, as told by her through her storybook!
translation: Yoshida Aikou只是一个普通的高中二年级女生。她心地善良，所以今年情人节，她要给学校里的每个男生送巧克力！跟随她的故事书，一同踏上这场天马行空的冒险吧！
